researchNotes: BJ Distribuzione page returned empty content. Official site (thespiritofdubai.com) range pages g1products.php, g2products.php, g2accordproducts.php list 12 First Generation perfumes, 8 Second Generation (Ultra-Niche) and 7 Accord Collection perfumes; notes, family and concentration read from each product page. Official pages give no perfumer, year or accords, so these are null/[]. Dubai Bakhoor (150 g incense, listed on the First Generation page) excluded as not a perfume. Fragrantica/Parfumo/Parfinity/scentverdict returned 403 or were not needed. Product page note lists are very long and include marketing terms, kept as published (lowercased). Country not stated on pages read; UAE inferred from Dubai branding. Country left null: no page states it. Pass 3: official range page is behind a bot check (no content via WebFetch); no new data added. Performance values added from retailer and review-site snippets only where a source stated them.

fragrances.name: Dubai Marsa

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Marsa

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragrantica user reviews 9-10 h; Steam Perfume over 12 h with intense sillage early on; Parfinity 9/10 longevity and 8/10 sillage; Parfumo about 8.9 longevity and 8.4 sillage. Most views: 9-12 h, strong sillage, so longevity 4 and sillage 4. One review disagrees, not used.

fragrances.name: Dubai Ajyal

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Ajyal

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Parfums: often 10 hours or more with strong, bold sillage; Maxaroma 10+ h; community reviews about 8-10 h (Parfumo averages about 8.4 longevity and 8.1 sillage). Most views: 8-10+ h and strong sillage, so longevity 4 and sillage 4.

fragrances.name: Dubai Roeya

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Roeya

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailers 10-12 h with strong sillage (up to 12-15 h with caveats); Parfumo users 8.2 longevity and 7.8 sillage; Fragrantica reviewers moderate to strong sillage. Dissent: one reviewer says almost no lasting power. Most views: 10-12 h, moderate to strong sillage.

fragrances.name: Dubai Oud

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Oud

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentsangel over 8 h with strong sillage; Beautinow 8-10 h, moderate to heavy; Maxaroma 8-10+ h; Parfumo about 9.2 longevity and 8.8 sillage. Most views: 8+ h and strong sillage. One reviewer reports only 4-5 h, not used as the common view.

fragrances.name: Dubai Bahar

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Bahar
The Scent Base — Bahar community wear report

fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base: about 6-10 h (score 4.2); Maxaroma claims 10+ h; no usable sillage figure found.

fragrances.name: Dubai Rimal

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Rimal

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 8-10 h, strong sillage but not overpowering; Beautinow: moderate-to-heavy sillage, strong projection; Maxaroma claims 10+ h.

fragrances.name: Dubai Turath

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Turath

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Zaoud test and other sellers cite 10-12+ h on skin; Vivir community scores about 5.0 longevity and 4.0 sillage out of 5; Parfinity's under-4-h entry looks like an outlier.

fragrances.name: Dubai Abraj

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Abraj

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow: 8-10 h, moderate sillage; Scents Angel: 10-12 h, strong sillage; sources disagree on sillage so it is left blank.

fragrances.name: Dubai Meydan

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Meydan

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Fragplace: reviews put it at 10+ h with powerful sillage; Beautinow: moderate-to-heavy sillage; Scents Angel 8-12 h, Maxaroma claims 12+ h.

ScentVerdict — The Spirit of Dubai Fakhama EDP

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict and a Parfinity reviewer describe strong sillage; a listing says moderate-to-heavy; longevity claims range from 5-6 h to 12+ h so it is left blank.

fragrances.name: Dubai Majalis

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Majalis

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow: 8-10 h and sillage 8/10; The Scent Base: 8+ h, projection rated monster; Scents Angel claims 10+ h.

fragrances.name: Dubai Sama

sources.name: The Spirit of Dubai — Dubai Sama
Maxaroma — The Spirit of Dubai Sama

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Maxaroma lists longevity 12-20+ h (seller claim); no sillage figure found.

fragrances.name: Narjesi
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel 8-10 h with moderate to strong sillage; Parfumo users about 9/10 longevity and 8.7/10 sillage (community scores, read as strong longevity). Longevity 4; sillage 3 as the retailer's moderate-to-strong view is the more conservative one.

fragrances.name: Durra
fragrances.family: Woody, Oriental, Ambery, Leathery, Marine Notes, Boise
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scentsangel 8-12 h and strong sillage; Beautinow 8-10 h, moderate to heavy; Maxaroma 12-14+ h; Parfumo averages about 9.1 longevity and 8.8 sillage. Most figures give 8-12 h, so longevity 4; sillage strong, so 4.

fragrances.name: Baz
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Retailers 8-12 h and a summary of moderate-to-strong sillage; Parfumo reviewers report very strong sillage at first, then a skin scent after about 12 h, with longevity scored 9-10/10 by some. Most views: 8-12 h, sillage moderate to strong.

fragrances.name: Aamal
fragrances.performanceEvidence: The Scent Base: 8+ h, projection monster; Beautinow: 8-10 h, heavy sillage; Scents Angel: strong sillage.

fragrances.name: Abjar
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel 10-14 h with strong sillage; Beauti Now 8-10 h with heavy sillage; one Fragrantica reviewer about 12 h with very strong projection; another reviewer says only several hours. Most views: 8-14 h and strong to heavy sillage, so longevity 4 and sillage 4.

fragrances.name: Haibah
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel 8-12 h with moderate to strong sillage; Beauti Now 8-10 h, moderate to heavy sillage; Parfumo users rate longevity and sillage above average. Maxaroma's 12-24 h is marketing copy and not used. Most views: 8-12 h, sillage moderate to strong, so 3.

fragrances.name: Diwan
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Parfumo users 9.2 longevity and 9.0 sillage; Beauti Now 8-10 h, moderate to heavy sillage; Fragrantica reviewers moderate to strong sillage; some vendors claim 12-14+ h. Most views: longevity strong, sillage moderate to strong, so 3 for sillage.
